name: 2019 High Volume FHV Trip Records
description:
This dataset contains a sample of 5,000 trip records for high-volume for-hire vehicles (FHVs) from 2019, likely covering app-based rideshare and car services in New York City. Each row represents a single trip and includes the vehicle operator's license number, the dispatching base, pickup and drop-off timestamps, pickup and drop-off location IDs, and a shared-ride flag.

The license number field identifies four distinct operators, with HV0003 accounting for about 70% of trips and HV0005 about 22%. Dispatching base numbers show 31 distinct bases. Pickup and drop-off times are recorded to the second, allowing trip durations to be calculated. Location IDs range from 1 to 265 and correspond to taxi zones, enabling geographic analysis of trip origins and destinations. The shared-ride flag is present for only about 23% of records and is always 1 when present, so it indicates flagged shared trips but cannot distinguish non-shared
